attributes.name: SDLC ingest stalled (schedule-aware)

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM vp-ingest-freshness
| WHERE source NOT IN ("salesforce-catalog-cases", "slack-channel-history", "slack-thread-replies", "slack-catalog-users", "cross-link-sdh-product", "github-catalog-sdh-labeled-issues", "github-catalog-sdh-issues", "github-extract-drive-links", "gdrive-catalog-roadmap-docs")
| EVAL max_age_hours = CASE(
    source IN ("github-activity-issues", "github-activity-pull-requests", "github-enrich-issues-graph", "github-enrich-pull-requests-graph", "agent-pr-missing-related-issue"), 3,
    source IN ("cross-link-feedback-loop", "github-cross-link-entities", "github-enrich-epic-phases", "github-normalize-project-items", "github-project-epic-phases"), 18,
    30)
| EVAL age_hours = DATE_DIFF("hours", last_write, NOW())
| WHERE age_hours > max_age_hours
| KEEP source, doc_count_total, last_write, age_hours, max_age_hours
| SORT age_hours DESC

attributes.description: Fires when a sync source has not written documents for longer than its own schedule allows. Thresholds are per-source (3h for 30m/1h workflows, 18h for 2h/6h, 30h for 12h/1d) at roughly 2.5x the interval, so one missed run is tolerated and two consecutive misses alert. A flat threshold cannot work here: the catalog workflows run every: 1d, so a 6h rule reported them stalled for 18 hours of every day and buried genuine stalls in permanent noise. Sources owned by workflows that ship disabled (Salesforce, Slack, Drive, SDH) are excluded: a source nobody enabled is not a stall, and alerting on it trains people to ignore the rule.
